description: Studio apartment, 1 shower bathroom, open plan living-kitchen-dining, 1 storage room. Single-aspect apartment — windows on top facade(s). Kitchen is on an interior wall away from windows — less natural light at the cooking position. Studio apartment. Sleeping area: unclear bed. Separation from living area: none. Kitchen: L-shaped, no island. Cook partially faces the living area depending on position at counter. No wall separates kitchen from dining and living — fully open plan. Living area arrangement: linear kitchen-dining-living. Dining table visible, approximately 4 seats. Bathroom config: 1 shower-only bathroom(s). Single bathroom — sequential morning routine. Storage room adjacent to kitchen — usable as kitchen pantry, laundry room or general storage. Entry area has space for coat and shoe storage. From entry: kitchen is immediate, living area is long corridor. Door separates entry corridor from living area. Suits: singles or couples.
not_suitable_for: household requiring separate rooms for different functions simultaneously
